channel.title: Paksh: Sports
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: A'ja Wilson Wins Record Fifth WNBA MVP Award
item.description: A'ja Wilson has won her fifth WNBA MVP award, setting a new record. This marks a significant achievement in her career. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Darian Mensah and Miami FC Focus on Process Amid Winning Streak
item.description: Darian Mensah and No. 4 Miami FC are concentrating on their process despite a strong start to the season. The team remains focused on the steps and routines that have contributed to their success. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Oregon Ducks QB Dylan Raiola to Start Against UCLA
item.description: Dylan Raiola is set to start as quarterback for the Oregon Ducks in their game against UCLA, with teammate Bo Nix ruled out. Raiola's leadership is noted as easing the team's transition at the quarterback position. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Wallabies Coach Rennie Defends Suaalii Selection for Bledisloe Cup
item.description: Wallabies coach Dave Rennie has defended his decision to keep Joseph Suaalii on the wing for the Bledisloe Cup Test, stating the selection "is not about me." Rennie brushed off speculation about his own position amid reports of potential… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: ICC Men's T20 World Cup Asia Sub‑Regional Qualifiers 2026 set for Kuala Lumpur
item.description: The ICC Men's T20 World Cup Asia Sub‑Regional Qualifier A match 10 was held in Kuala Lumpur on 9 October 2026, while the Qualifier B series of the 2026 tournament is also being contested, with live scores and results reported. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Sports Ministry Reviews Asian Games Performance After Athlete Shortfalls
item.description: The Sports Ministry is set to review the performance of athletes at the Asian Games, with a particular focus on 89 athletes supported by the Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS) who did not secure a medal. This review comes after the Asian… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Shreyas Iyer Climbs ICC Rankings After Century Against West Indies
item.description: Shreyas Iyer has gained 18 places in the ICC rankings to enter the top-10 T20 batters after scoring a century against the West Indies in Lucknow. Iyer became the first Indian captain to score a T20I century while chasing a target. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 2.

item.title: Bhuvneshwar Kumar recalled to India T20I squad after four years
item.description: Bhuvneshwar Kumar was recalled to India’s Twenty‑20 International squad after an absence of nearly four years, with fast‑bowling all‑rounder Ajit Agarkar no longer in the squad. The surprise selection has been described by some… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: Yashasvi Jaiswal Learning New Skills for Indian Cricket Team
item.description: Indian cricketer Yashasvi Jaiswal is reportedly learning new skills to secure his place in the national team. Mumbai captain Siddhesh Lad revealed that Jaiswal is preparing to become a wicketkeeper, a role he wishes to fulfill for Team… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Ronaldo seeks apology after Portugal team walkout
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo has sought an apology and punishment for what he described as an "absolute breach of trust" by Portugal coach Jesus. Ronaldo alleged that Jesus had broken a promise to start him in a match and reneged on an agreement to… Coverage: Left 5 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Braves defeat Phillies 6-2 with three home runs
item.description: The Atlanta Braves defeated the Philadelphia Phillies 6-2 in a baseball game. The Braves hit three home runs, including a three-run shot by Harris, to secure the win and advance to face the Dodgers. Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 9 · Right 0.

item.title: Cricket selectors face dilemma over opening batsman selection
item.description: Former India cricketer Cheteshwar Pujara has publicly supported Sanju Samson for an opening batsman position, stating he will get an opportunity at the right time. The selection debate also involves Vaibhav Suryavanshi. Sunil Gavaskar has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 2.

item.title: NFL reverses fine for player's beer-chugging celebration
item.description: The NFL has reversed a $15,000 fine issued to San Francisco 49ers player Kyle Juszczyk for pretending to chug a beverage on the field. The league initially deemed the celebration a violation but later stated it is permissible. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Georgia and Alabama Set for High-Stakes SEC Football Clash Amidst Weather Concerns
item.description: The No. 2 ranked Georgia Bulldogs are scheduled to play the No. 6 ranked Alabama Crimson Tide in a significant Southeastern Conference (SEC) football game. The matchup is a clash between two unbeaten conference contenders. The game's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Australian Open Announces 1 Point Slam Event
item.description: The Australian Open has announced a new event called the '1 Point Slam' scheduled for January. Tennis stars Carlos Alcaraz, Naomi Osaka, and Jannik Sinner have already signed up to participate in this event. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Western Kentucky Defeats Missouri State in Football Game
item.description: Western Kentucky secured a 34-13 victory over Missouri State in a football game. Ajay Allen was a key player for Western Kentucky, rushing for 105 yards and scoring 2 touchdowns. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jon Rahm Departs LIV Golf Circuit
item.description: Golfer Jon Rahm has announced his departure from the LIV Golf circuit. The move is described as a blow to the circuit, which is facing financial difficulties and is referred to as "embattled." One report indicates Rahm's decision followed… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Gambhir's message to outgoing selector Agarkar
item.description: Cricketer Gautam Gambhir has conveyed a message to outgoing chief selector Ajit Agarkar, stating "History will be kinder to you." The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has thanked Agarkar for his three-year tenure, which… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 1.

item.title: Sahibzada Farhan Appointed Pakistan's New T20I Captain
item.description: Sahibzada Farhan has been appointed as the new T20I captain for Pakistan, marking the third captaincy change in the last three years. This appointment follows the sacking of Salman Ali Agha from the role. The Pakistan Cricket Board made… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Kusal Mendis Appointed Sri Lanka Test Captain
item.description: Kusal Mendis has been appointed as the new Test captain of Sri Lanka, replacing Dhananjaya de Silva. De Silva stated that it is time for the next generation to take over. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Ravindra Jadeja Asks About Selector Role After Ajit Agarkar's Departure
item.description: Cricketer Ravindra Jadeja has publicly inquired about the process of applying for a selector position following the departure of Ajit Agarkar. Jadeja reportedly asked how to apply for the role, with the timing of his question coinciding… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Suryakumar Yadav dropped from Mumbai Indians squad
item.description: Suryakumar Yadav has been excluded from the Mumbai Indians squad. Selectors cited a lack of experience with the red ball as the reason for his omission, with reports indicating that all selectors had previously refused to consider him due… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Jannik Sinner Out for Remainder of Year Due to Knee Injury
item.description: Jannik Sinner will not compete for the remainder of the year due to knee inflammation. This announcement comes as Alexander Zverev is set to become the World No. 1. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: England Dominates Croatia 7-0 in Nations League Match
item.description: England secured a decisive 7-0 victory over Croatia in a UEFA Nations League match on October 3rd. Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka each scored two goals, while Jude Bellingham contributed one goal and three assists. Anthony Gordon and Morgan… Coverage: Left 4 · Centre 7 · Right 0.

item.title: Abhishek Sharma Breaks Rohit Sharma's Record in T20Is
item.description: Abhishek Sharma has set a new record for the most sixes by an Indian in the first over of a T20 International match, surpassing Rohit Sharma's previous record. Ishan Kishan is ranked third in this category. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Shubman Gill and Abhishek Sharma Nominated for ICC Player of the Month
item.description: Shubman Gill and Abhishek Sharma have been nominated for the ICC Player of the Month award. They are in contention with Zimbabwe's captain, who is also challenging for the title. The coverage highlights the statistics of both Indian… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: India Defeats West Indies in T20I; Iyer Hits Century, Dhir Impresses on Debut
item.description: India secured an 8-wicket victory over the West Indies in a T20 International match. Shreyas Iyer scored his maiden T20I century, while debutant Naman Dhir took 3 wickets and contributed to the win. Dhir expressed his anticipation for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: India vs Uruguay Football Match Sees Low Turnout Despite Ticket Price Cuts
item.description: Despite a significant 90% price reduction on tickets, with some originally priced at ₹1,999 now available for ₹199, the Salt Lake Stadium in Kolkata saw a low turnout for the India vs Uruguay football match. Anirudh Thapa scored for India… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: UEFA Investigates Spitting Allegation in Ireland vs. Israel Match
item.description: UEFA has launched an investigation into an alleged spitting incident during the Ireland vs. Israel football match. Reports indicate the incident has taken a toll on the Irish players. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Shubman Gill, Abhishek Sharma Nominated for ICC Player of the Month
item.description: Indian cricketers Shubman Gill and Abhishek Sharma have been nominated for the ICC Player of the Month award. They are among the nominees for the prestigious monthly honor. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Sydney Roosters Win NRL Grand Final, Daniel Tupou Retires
item.description: The Sydney Roosters have won the NRL grand final, defeating the Knights in a tense match. Following the victory, player Daniel Tupou announced his retirement. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Patriots Players Gonzalez and Barmore Out for Bills Game
item.description: New England Patriots players Christian Gonzalez and Christian Barmore will not play in the upcoming game against the Buffalo Bills. Coach Mike Vrabel also discussed the shoulder injury of Drake Maye. Gonzalez spoke about the Patriots'… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Utd and Tottenham Players Suffer Injuries Ahead of Match
item.description: Ahead of a match between Manchester United and Tottenham, players from both teams have sustained injuries. Micky van de Ven, a player for Tottenham, has an injury, with Xavi providing an update on his condition. Separately, an England… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Gavin McKenna Scores First NHL Goal for Toronto Maple Leafs
item.description: Gavin McKenna, the first overall pick in the 2026 NHL Draft, scored his first career goal for the Toronto Maple Leafs in an overtime victory. McKenna also registered his first assist in the game. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: India A Loses to Australia A by 125 Runs in Match
item.description: India A lost to Australia A by 125 runs in a match where Australia A was bowled out before completing 50 overs. India A was set a target of 275 runs. Suryansh took 4 wickets, and Yash and Arshad performed well for India A. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Medvedev disqualified after hitting fan, Djokovic advances to China Open final
item.description: Russian tennis player Daniil Medvedev was disqualified from the China Open after hitting a spectator in the face with a ball. The incident occurred during his match against Novak Djokovic, who subsequently advanced to the final. Medvedev… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 2.

item.title: Nasir Lone Impresses in Irani Cup for Jammu & Kashmir
item.description: Nasir Lone made a significant impact for Jammu & Kashmir in the Irani Cup, taking three wickets and scoring 64 runs. His performance helped boost his team's innings. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: France defeats Belgium in Nations League match
item.description: France secured a 4-1 victory over Belgium in a Nations League match, with substitute players Olise and Doue playing key roles in the turnaround. Olise was instrumental in powering France to the win. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Coco Gauff denounces online racism after China Open dispute
item.description: Tennis player Coco Gauff has spoken out against what she described as an "insane" amount of online racism directed at her following a video review dispute during the China Open tournament. The incident occurred during her participation in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Patriots Receiver's Girlfriend's Reaction to Game-Winning Touchdown
item.description: During a New England Patriots game, the girlfriend of receiver A.J. Brown celebrated his game-winning touchdown in an unusual manner, reportedly urinating her pants. Brown later posted a reaction to the touchdown catch. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.
